name: Casa nobre · Interior
prompt: Precise-object-edit of the supplied furnished Casa nobre battlemap interior. Preserve the exact outer wall rectangle, wall thickness, floor texture, centered bottom door gap and all original window positions. Correct OVERSIZED furniture and handheld objects to REAL HUMAN SCALE relative to a standard human TOKEN of ONE 1.5-metre grid square. The building canvas is 7 by 7 grid squares; the clear floor is approximately 4.62 squares wide and 4.34 squares high. Treat this as an invisible measuring grid, never draw it. Furniture must obey these REAL dimensions: single bed 0.65 by 1.4 squares, double bed 1.05 by 1.4 squares, chair or stool 0.35 by 0.35 squares, dining table 1.4 by 0.65 squares, desk/workbench 1.4 by 0.5 squares, cabinet/bookcase modules 1.2 by 0.35 squares, sofa 1.3 by 0.5 squares, barrel 0.4 squares diameter, anvil 0.6 by 0.3 squares, quenching basin 0.5 squares diameter, small box/basket 0.3 squares wide, ordinary bath 0.6 by 1.2 squares, forge 1.2 by 1 squares. Small objects on tables must be normal handheld size: cups 10cm, plates 25cm, books 20-30cm, tools 25-55cm, never giant table-covering ornaments. Beds must never be 3-4 metres long. Shrink oversized movable pieces substantially, around 50-60% of their current linear dimensions, until they match these measurements. Retain the kind and purpose of the furnished room, arranging the correctly sized pieces around its edges with clear walking routes. Large commercial rooms may contain sensible repeated small tables, beds, shelves or workstations; do not enlarge individual furniture to fill the room. Keep built-in wall fireplaces and hearths in their EXACT original positions, size and material so the matching empty room remains consistent. STRICT VERTICAL ORTHOGRAPHIC NADIR view: all furniture shows only top-facing surfaces. Circular barrel/tub tops, opaque TOP boards over bookcases and wardrobes (NO book-spine fronts or doors), U-shaped horizontal TOP CUT fireplace/forge rims. Zero camera tilt, no isometric, no standing facade or legs. Keep the same detailed hand-painted medieval natural materials and lighting. Transparent alpha outside the complete wall outline. No human, token, scale marker, grid, ruler, labels, text, roof, door leaf, stairs, outdoor terrain or watermark.
